annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley: Información y responsabilidad de proveedores en el uso de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill: Information and Responsibility of Providers in the Use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación (Argentina) – legislator sponsor
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill amending the Consumer Protection Law 24.240 to require providers to disclose AI use, guarantee non-discrimination, and bear liability for harms from automated decisions, with administrative sanctions. General AI consumer-protection measure with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Art. 4 and 8 of Law 24.240 to require disclosure of AI use in products, services, and digital media
Providers must explain how AI systems work and what data they use
Providers must ensure AI systems do not perpetuate unfair bias or discrimination
Providers liable for harm from automated decisions, with aggravated application of Art. 52 bis
Sanctions under Art. 47 including fines, suspension of activity, or license withdrawal
